description.value: Pampanga's Cuisine is a Filipino family-owned restaurant that expanded to its Fraser Street location in 2022, following the success of its original Joyce Street spot. It specializes in authentic Kapampangan dishes served turo-turo style — pre-cooked dishes displayed buffet-style in food warmers — alongside all-day breakfast silogs, classic Filipino desserts, and Goldilocks bakery products. The restaurant also offers full catering services for events of all sizes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the OSM address (6094 Fraser Street) as the second Pampanga's Cuisine location, opened in 2022. Takeout is explicitly mentioned on the /about page ('Available for dine-in or takeout!'). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website; OSM tags also provide none of these details.
concerns: OSM record had no phone number; phone (604) 566 0505 taken from website for the Fraser Street location.
Website serves two locations (5179 Joyce St and 6094 Fraser St); this OSM record is specific to the Fraser Street location only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Filipino restaurant with confirmed address and active website. A useful food stop for touring cyclists on Fraser Street.
